sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Eb]O Shepherd divine, I know Thou art mine; Thy [Bb7]search in the night was for [Eb]me.
[Eb]This bleak world is cold, but warm is Thy fold; My [Bb7]Shepherd, I follow [Eb]Thee.
[Eb]Thro' pastures serene, Thro' valleys of green, My [Bb7]Shepherd, I follow [Eb]Thee.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Eb]Thy grace and [Ab]Thy law I [Eb]picture in awe;
[Eb]Ah! life that [Bb7]was given to [Eb]ransom my soul,
[Eb]Ah! heart that [Bb7]was broken to [Eb]make sinners whole,
[Eb]This world is [Bb7]but loss In [Eb]view of Thy cross,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Eb]I thrill at [Bb7]Thy marvelous love [Eb]to Thy sheep,
[Eb]The way Thou [Bb7]dost lead to [Eb]the still waters deep,
[Eb]One staff and [Bb7]one rod, One [Eb]fold and one God,
